text:
A bell serene
crucified in your ritmo
define to the morning
with peluca of mist
and arroyos of tears.
My old chopo
turbio of ruiseñores
esperaba
put between the hierbas
your branches
mucho antes that the autumn
lo dorara.
But the puntales
of my gazes
lo sostenían.
¡Old chopo, aguarda!
¿No you feel the madera
of my love torn?
Tiéndete in the pradera
when cruja my soul,
that a vendaval of besos
and words
has left rendida,
lacerada.

translation.title: A bell
